$comment: Licence policy for NeoPrint (plan section 2.0). Changing this file is a deliberate policy decision and must be recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/THIRD_PARTY.md.

Hangfire.Core.reason: Free edition, used unmodified as a NuGet package (no linking changes). Hangfire Pro is not used. Plan section 2.0.

QuestPDF.reason: QuestPDF Community licence: free for companies with annual revenue below 1M USD. The condition is recorded in docs/THIRD_PARTY.md and must be re-checked as the business grows. Plan section 2.0.

packageLicenses.$comment: Resolved licence for packages whose metadata ships a licence file instead of an SPDX expression. Each entry must be verified against the package's own LICENSE before being added.

pinnedMajors.$comment: These are the last freely licensed major versions. Raising a major version changes the licence to a commercial one, so the check fails on anything outside the pinned major.

MediatR.reason: MediatR v13 and later require a commercial licence.

MassTransit.reason: MassTransit v9 and later require a commercial licence.

MassTransit.RabbitMQ.reason: MassTransit v9 and later require a commercial licence.

MassTransit.MongoDb.reason: MassTransit v9 and later require a commercial licence.

MassTransit.Abstractions.reason: MassTransit v9 and later require a commercial licence.

FluentAssertions.reason: FluentAssertions v8 and later require a commercial licence.

bannedPackages.$comment: Packages explicitly ruled out in plan section 2.0 ('Lisenziyaya gore istifade edilmeyenler'). Listed by name so an accidental transitive pull is reported rather than silently accepted.
bannedPackages.Magick.NET-Q16-AnyCPU: Not needed: SkiaSharp covers image processing.
bannedPackages.FluentValidation: Not needed: DataAnnotations plus our own validators.
bannedPackages.Mapster: Not needed: mapping is written by hand.
bannedPackages.AutoMapper: Not needed: mapping is written by hand.
bannedPackages.Refit: Not needed: HttpClient is used directly.
bannedPackages.CliWrap: Not needed: System.Diagnostics.Process is used directly.
bannedPackages.PDFtoImage: Replaced by our own NeoPrint.Pdfium P/Invoke wrapper.
bannedPackages.PdfSharpCore: Replaced by the official PDFsharp package.
bannedPackages.FirebaseAdmin: Replaced by our own FCM HTTP v1 client.
bannedPackages.Moq: Plan section 11: no mocking library, fakes are written by hand.
bannedPackages.NSubstitute: Plan section 11: no mocking library, fakes are written by hand.
bannedPackages.FakeItEasy: Plan section 11: no mocking library, fakes are written by hand.
